title: Service incident follow-up
summary: [00:00-00:51] Incident timeline — Participant A reviews the previous day’s notification delay; Participant B reports that the queue began growing at 9:12, an alert arrived at 9:20, and processing returned to normal at 9:41 after workers were restarted • [00:51-01:18] Recovery status — Participant A asks whether the affected records completed; Participant B confirms that the records checked had eventually completed • [01:18-02:06] Possible cause — Participant B notes that a deployment and worker restart occurred near the start of the incident; the cause remains unclear, with a connection-pool issue one possibility to investigate • [02:06-02:52] Traces & alerting — Participant B will compare traces, and Participant A will test alternative alert rules to see whether delays can be detected sooner before changing production settings • [02:52-03:23] Duplicate report — Participant C reports a duplicate confirmation after a retry; Participant B discusses including it in the investigation • [03:23-03:55] Support update — Participant C will communicate that processing has recovered and investigation is continuing • [03:55-04:26] Recovery checklist — Participant A points out that the recovery checklist needs clearer wording about restarting workers rather than clearing the queue
